page_title: MAR 6-2 HAV | Marseille v Le Havre 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' 6 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Bilal Nadir sets up Michael Murillo (Marseille) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the left side of the goal. 6:2.

90+2' 5 - 2 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top left corner of the net.
90' Michael Murillo (Marseille) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

88' 5 - 1 Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Robinio Vaz (Marseille) latches on to it and finishes with a quick low shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 5:1.
84' Ayumu Seko will be replaced by Younes Namli (Le Havre).
84' Didier Digard has decided to make a change. Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) replaces Yassine Kechta.
83' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Darryl Bakola (Marseille) is coming onto the pitch as Mason Greenwood cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) is booked by the referee.
76' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Benjamin Pavard tees up Mason Greenwood (Marseille) inside the box and he curls the ball into the right side of the net and past Mory Diaw.
74' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

72' 3 - 1 Mason Greenwood (Marseille) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Robinio Vaz, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:1.
71' Igor Paixao goes off the pitch and Timothy Weah (Marseille) comes on.
71' Igor Paixao (Marseille) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
67' 2 - 1 Goal! Igor Paixao slips it to Mason Greenwood (Marseille) on the edge of the box and he finds the right side of the net with a great effort. The score is 2:1.
65' Substitution. Bilal Nadir (Marseille) replaces Matt O'Riley.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Angel Gomes leaves the pitch and Robinio Vaz (Marseille) comes on.
65' The game has come to an end for Emerson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Michael Murillo (Marseille).
65' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye is replaced by Simon Ebonog (Le Havre).
65' Fode Doucoure comes off the pitch to be replaced by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre).
63' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
56' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
56' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
54' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
54' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle after Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Marseille are awarded a free kick.
52' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Issa Soumare (Le Havre) heads on.

48' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
47' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
46' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' Angel Gomes (Marseille) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
45+6' Emerson (Marseille) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top right corner, but Mory Diaw easily deals with the threat.
45+4' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Bastien Dechepy's book.
45+4' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Bastien Dechepy and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

45+4' Igor Paixao (Marseille) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
45+3' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
45+1' Mory Diaw comes off his line to intercept the corner from Mason Greenwood (Marseille).

45+1' A terrific piece of skill by Igor Paixao (Marseille) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten. The ball goes out for a corner. Marseille can continue in their attacking effort.
45' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.

45' Nayef Aguerd (Marseille) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick is awarded to Le Havre.
44' Emerson (Marseille) sends the corner into the box, but Mory Diaw intercepts it and averts the threat.
44' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Marseille have a corner.
42' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
41' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) trips an opposition player and Bastien Dechepy signals a foul. Marseille have been awarded a free kick.
38' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Ally Samatta will be replaced by Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre).
35' 1 - 1 Goal! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty low past Mory Diaw into the middle of the goal.
35' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
34' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Gautier Lloris (Le Havre). He’s got to go!
32' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Gautier Lloris (Le Havre)! Let's see what he decides.
32' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Bastien Dechepy pulls out a yellow card.
31' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) handles the ball inside the penalty area. No point in arguing there. Marseille will take a penalty kick.
30' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

29' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save. Le Havre will take a corner kick.
28' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
24' 0 - 1 Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Jeffrey De Lange with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
23' Marseille are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
19' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) sends a rebound goalwards towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
16' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Mory Diaw.
14' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
13' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

12' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
10' Mory Diaw is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Nayef Aguerd (Marseille). Easy save!
8' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) is adjudged offside.
8' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
6' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) makes a slide tackle, but referee Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul.
5' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
2' Angel Gomes (Marseille) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Bastien Dechepy will officiate today.
